invalidated_evidence.source: Diagnostic read only of previous source log; no source tests are rerun.

command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$log = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath "C:\dev\flyExplorer\logs\winui-scoped" -Filter "*-source.log" -File |
  Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
  Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $log) { throw "source log missing" }
Write-Host ("SOURCE_LOG=" + $log.FullName)
Get-Content -LiteralPath $log.FullName |
  Select-String -Pattern "FAIL:","ERROR:","AssertionError","Traceback","test_" -Context 1,4 |
  ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_.ToString() }
